external_actions.title: Portal Save uv-capable env onto ICML automation
external_actions.instructions: Open https://cursor.com/automations/bf73dff3-8f7a-11f1-a7d1-d6b4613131ce → Environment → Save/attach the latest uv-capable draft (855d7b11-9279-11f1-ba66-0e7d0216e441, build bld-20260807-6bb19bfe-…). Do NOT use older Tick 30–44 drafts. Personal transitional drafts are NOT inherited by cron until Portal Saved onto the automation.

external_actions.title: Accept HuggingFace Idavidrein/gpqa access
external_actions.instructions: With the HF account behind HF_TOKEN, accept access to https://huggingface.co/datasets/Idavidrein/gpqa so --fetch-diamond can materialize GPQA diamond.
